translations.web: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”
translations.bsb: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
translations.kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
translations.asv: And Judas, who betrayed him, answered and said, Is it I, Rabbi? He saith unto him, Thou hast said.
